jei.info.elemenic_infuser: The Elemenic Infuser is used to automatically deconstruct items placed inside it, then infuse the stored elemenix into an elemenic analyzer or elemenic storage.
jei.info.elemenic_enricher: The Elemenic Enricher automatically deconstructs items into elemenix and stores it, then enriches the stored elemenix into the corresponding essence.
jei.info.elemenic_ejector: The Elemenic Ejector is an upgraded version of the elemenic enricher. It can eject the enriched essence as item drops.
jei.info.geological_simulator: The Geological Simulator is an elemenic transformer that oxidizes metallix into terrix using flumix by simulating geological processes. The player needs to place pure flumix items and pure metallix items into the device.
jei.info.metallurgical_activator: The Metallurgical Activator is an elemenic transformer capable of reducing terrix back into metallix using the immense energy contained within energix. The player needs to place pure terrix items and pure energix items into the device.
jei.info.germinal_accelerator: The Germinal Accelerator is an elemenic transformer that provides the environment necessary for the genesis of life, cultivating flumix and terrix into living organix. The player needs to place pure terrix items and pure flumix items into the device.
jei.info.transpiring_incinerator: The Transpiring Incinerator is an elemenic transformer. By utilizing energix to provide substantial thermal energy, it intensifies the transpiration process of organix, generating large amounts of flumix. The player needs to place pure organix items and pure energix items into the device.
jei.info.optical_capturer: The Optical Capturer is an elemenic transformer. It accelerates the photosynthesis of organix using flumix, converting the captured light energy into energix. The player needs to place pure organix items and pure flumix items into the device.
jei.info.throttle_valve: The Throttle Valve is used in the elemenic ejector to limit the maximum number of items ejected per launch. When held in the player's main hand, right-click to adjust the valve's opening level.
jei.info.flow_straightener: The Flow Straightener restricts the ejection sequence of the elemenic ejector. When installed, the ejector will launch the stored elemenic essence from left to right. Additionally, an ejector equipped with a flow straightener can perform enrichment and ejection simultaneously.
jei.info.memory_burner: The Memory Burner is used to edit the item sequence stored in a memorizer. It allows for operations such as moving, swapping, and deleting items, and supports copying or merging the list to another memorizer.
jei.info.elemenic_storage: The Elemenic Storage is used to temporarily hold elemenix stored by the elemenic infuser, and can also establish a connection with a remote elemenic storage. When needed, the player can transfer the elemenix from the storage into an analyzer, using a method similar to deconstructing items.
jei.info.remote_elemenic_storage: The Remote Elemenic Storage is used to remotely access elemenix from an elemenic storage. This item does not directly store any elemenix itself; it merely provides the player with a method to transfer the elemenix reserves without having to retrieve the physical storage unit.
